what_happened: The person running Athena wrote a request to allow two jobs to run at once and limited the change to athena.toml. Three drain tests read the real athena.toml and assume one job at a time. A config-only change would have broken them, so it could not pass. The person noticed this and re-queued the request with those tests in scope. This is an intervention note, not a failed job record.
cause: Athena does not list which tests read the live athena.toml, so a config-change request or reading cannot be checked against its dependent tests. The scope was set from memory of the one file being edited. Nothing maps each config setting to the tests that read it, and nothing warns that the allowed-edit set is too narrow. The gap shows only when someone notices that the tests would fail. The same cross-check is missing whether the scope comes from the person writing the request or from Athena's reading.
prevention: Add a check that runs when a request or reading changes athena.toml, or a setting in it. It finds every test that loads the live athena.toml, for example by searching tests for reads of the config path or loader. It then compares those tests with the allowed-edit scope. It flags any such test that is not in scope, and lists the tests so the request can include them. It could also run the changed config against those tests before dispatch. That would have shown that the three drain tests assume one job at a time.
proposed_request:
Outcome: Athena can run two jobs at the same time during a drain (max_concurrency = 2 in athena.toml), and the full test suite passes with that setting.

Scope: athena.toml, plus the three drain tests that read the real athena.toml and assume one job at a time. Update those tests so they set their own concurrency instead of depending on the live value, or so they pass with 2. Do not change other behavior.

Acceptance:
- athena.toml sets max_concurrency to 2.
- The three drain tests pass with that setting and do not depend on the live athena.toml value for concurrency.
- The whole test suite and the repo checks pass.
- The diff touches only athena.toml and those three tests.
